verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB offers a free dev instance (up to 4 vCPU / 8 GB, no credit card), which is a free sandbox separate from production compute. It also offers branches of production data on isolated compute that can be thrown away, and CHKit commands to validate and test schema and pipelines as code before deploying. Missing for 10: a documented local engine or emulator for offline development, in-depth docs on using the dev tier and branching for transformation workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
